1.explanation:
• Tabs/Tabs.mdx: the main documentation for the Tabs component, showing its responsive behavior, API, and design guidelines for when and how it turns into a dropdown.
• Tab/Tab.mdx: describes the individual Tab item implementation and ARIA roles needed for tablist semantics.
• TabContent/TabContent.mdx: shows how content panels are rendered and associated with each tab, necessary to verify correct markup when removing the dropdown.
• Dropdown/Dropdown.mdx: the documentation for the Dropdown component used under the hood in the collapsed variant, needed to understand how it’s wired into Tabs.
• ListBox/README.md: lists the base ListBox implementation that underpins Dropdown, providing details on ARIA listbox behavior which must be replaced or removed when eliminating the dropdown variant.
1.bug_scenario: The bug scenario shows that when the viewport (or container) width falls below a certain threshold, the Carbon Tabs component automatically switches from a horizontal tablist into a dropdown menu. The first image is the collapsed “dropdown” variant listing “Tab label 2”, “Tab label 1”, “Tab label 3”, and “Custom Label”. The second image is the full-width horizontal tablist with four tabs and an active bottom border under “Tab label 2” plus its associated content panel below. The problem is that this automatic switch is based on browser width (not container width) and replaces native tablist semantics with a listbox, which is confusing for screen readers. The request is to remove the dropdown variant entirely and always render horizontal tabs.
